narrative.overview: An explorer's field journal opens into a living fantasy landscape. Painted scenery provides wonder, parchment and brass make controls tactile, and crisp HTML/SVG keeps mathematics readable. This extends the approved world. Reviewer disposition is ship for initial Cos desktop/mobile screenshots only; all states are not visually certified.
keyCharacteristics: Painted scenes with CSS parchment and brass controls
Purposeful spatial motion with reduced-motion support
Dedicated painted obstacle assets with CSS-authored controls

rules.name: Explicit Sign Rule
rules.body: Color accompanies labels and signs; it never determines the mathematical answer.

rules.name: Digital Geometry Rule
rules.body: Render numbers, angles, signs, labels, and axes in HTML or SVG, never raster scenery.

dos: Do extend the existing Living Field Journal identity.
Do use causal spatial movement and preserve reduced-motion final states.
Do identify LandArt as crops of the existing style board, not four production landscape files.
donts: Don't introduce personified skill cards or glossy plastic styling.
Don't bake mathematical labels into images.
Don't animate a structural obstacle frame as if it were a hinged object.
Don't claim every state is visually certified.
